annotations.target_phrase: PART THREE. MIDNIGHT IN THE RUE JULES VERNE
annotations.annotation_text: Section title for the orbital phase of the mission, shifting the narrative to the orbital resort of Freeside and the artificial gravity spindle where the Tessier-Ashpool dynasty resides.
sources: Gibson, William. Neuromancer. Ace Books, 1984, p. 108.

annotations.target_phrase: Human DNA spreading out from gravity’s steep well like an oilslick.
annotations.annotation_text: Gibson's biological metaphor for space colonization: orbital habitats as an ecological and genetic spill from Earth's gravity well, driven by corporate surplus capital rather than humanitarian idealism.
sources: Gibson, William. Neuromancer. Ace Books, 1984, p. 108.

annotations.target_phrase: home to a family inbred and most carefully refined, the industrial clan of Tessier and Ashpool
annotations.annotation_text: Introduction of the Tessier-Ashpool corporate dynasty: an inbred transnational family whose gothic orbital stronghold, Villa Straylight, symbolizes the late-capitalist fusion of feudal aristocracy and autonomous AI infrastructure.
sources: Gibson, William. Neuromancer. Ace Books, 1984, p. 108.
